_comment: Author's published Stocksgeeks MBI 2.0 'EM' scores, used to calibrate the XP `const` so the regime bands align for our (all-bhavcopy ~4000) universe. XP is the open-source proxy for EM and shares EM's band structure, so EM values are valid XP calibration targets. Source: finallynitin MBI 2.0 table (ASIANENE chart), last refreshed 2026-06-12 EOD. NOTE: editing this file triggers an automatic const + output-map recalibration on the next daily bhavcopy run (and the daily generator drops partial-coverage bhavcopy days before fitting).
